newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.52 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.52 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended unchanged at 14.52 ringgit ($5.86) a kg, aided by a higher close of the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"The (local) market should have gone up on the LME's strength but there are many offerings too here," said a trader.
Traders noted initial bids for 122 tonnes against offers for 114. Final turnover was 114 tonnes, against 185 on Friday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
Traders said the local price remained at a discount of $30 against the LME.
